title: Told sensor research would be career-ending
place_text: US intelligence community / his own lab

tellings.quote:
intelligence community told me
>> like I was starting to work in my own
lab to reproduce it and to come up with
a sensor to sense this stuff.

plain: A former intelligence official named Eric Haseltine says that when he started working in his own lab to reproduce a phenomenon and build a sensor that could detect it, people in the US intelligence community told him it would end his career. He tells Michels this from his own experience, without saying exactly what "this stuff" was in the part quoted. If true, it suggests insiders were steered away from studying it.
